smartFlows are 1h per-wallet Smart Inflow card rows from the signed-in GMGN endpoint smartmoney_cards/cards/sol/1h (Monitor > Smart, 1h, https://gmgn.ai/monitor?chain=sol&tab=smartdegen), not the left-rail Smart Degen feed or Smart Net Inflow aggregates. Action labels First Buy / Buy More / Sell All / Sell Partial were taken from the API side + is_open_or_close fields (buy+1, buy+0, sell+1, sell+0) and checked against visible labels on inflow-0-initial.png. The inflow API was captured around 12:17 PM ET in the same signed-in session; the live board had already moved, so some on-screen cards are not identical to this tape. 0 wallet rows were skipped for a missing action, address, or net inflow.

walletFull (complete base58) was recorded from the API wallet_address field (the same full addresses GMGN exposes on wallet links). Wallet labels use a GMGN name/twitter/ENS label when the payload had one, otherwise the prefix...suffix abbreviation.
